title: Jimmy Ryan's on 52nd and 54th Street
summary: Moore clarifies which Ryan's he means and mentions five years there with Tony Parenti after the war.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I see. Did you ever go to Ryan's and sit in yourself?
I was down there... I don't remember what years. I was down there five years with Tony Parenti and his band.
That was just after the War, though.
But during the time that you were with Kirby, did you ever get a chance to take a break and go over there and play...?
No. You're speaking about Jimmy Ryan's on 54th Street, right?
But see, the Jimmy Ryan's on 52nd Street was down further. It's on the East Side. See, we was on the West Side.
